 (BY SHRI NARENDRA CHAURASIYA - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
This is the third bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.
His earlier applications were dismissed as withdrawn.

The applicant has been arrested on 13.03.2020 by Police Station Khurai, District Sagar in connection with Crime No.85/2020 registered in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2) (F), 506 & 450 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 and 5(N)/6 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offence Act, 2012.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case and he has not committed any offence in any manner.
There is delay in lodging the FIR.

Though the prosecutrix has deposed Hairnarayan Tiwri vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186983460/
1 against the applicant, but there are contradictions and omissions in her statement.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 13.03.2020 and he is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering his bail application.
In view of the aforesaid, he prays for grant of bail.
Per contra, learned counsel appearing for the State vehemently opposed the application stating that the prosecutrix who is a minor aged about 14 years has categorically deposed against the applicant.
Hence, no case for grant of bail is made out.
He has prayed for rejection of the bail application.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the prosecutrix who is a minor has categorically deposed against the applicant regarding commission of offence, this Court does not deem it appropriate to enlarge the applicant on bail at this stage.
Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.
